rom-1-22.anchor: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

rom-2-6.anchor: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

rom-2-11.anchor: For there is no respect of persons with God.

rom-2-18.anchor: approves the things that are more excellent

rom-2-26.anchor: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

rom-3-14.anchor: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

rom-3-15.anchor: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

rom-3-17.anchor: And the way of peace have they not known:

rom-3-18.anchor: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

rom-3-28.anchor: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

rom-3-29.anchor: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

rom-3-30.anchor: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

rom-4-4.anchor: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

rom-4-7.anchor: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

rom-4-23.anchor: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

rom-7-10.anchor: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

rom-9-2.anchor: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

rom-9-16.anchor: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

rom-11-7.anchor: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded

rom-11-23.anchor: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.

rom-11-24.anchor: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

rom-11-29.anchor: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

rom-11-34.anchor: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

rom-11-35.anchor: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

rom-12-4.anchor: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

rom-12-5.anchor: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

rom-12-14.anchor: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

rom-12-16.anchor: condescend to men of low estate

rom-12-18.anchor: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

rom-12-21.anchor: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

rom-14-7.anchor: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

rom-14-12.anchor: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

rom-14-16.anchor: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

rom-15-2.anchor: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

rom-15-10.anchor: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

rom-15-11.anchor: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

rom-15-21.anchor: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

rom-15-25.anchor: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

rom-15-29.anchor: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

rom-16-24.anchor: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
